Title: MODULAR MODE: Open/Save Blocks
Content: Objective Open and save Block component files (.ZBLC). Location Modular Mode Block Editor Operation Open 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Modular Mode Block Editor 2.Mouse over on a desired Modular Template. Open button appears. 3. Click Open button to load Block files. Save 1.Follow the indicated guideline below: Modular Mode Block Editor 2. Mouse over on a desired Modular Template. Save button appears. 3. Click Save button. A pop-up window appears. 4. Select a desired location with a desired file name and click Save button. Save Block Component window appears. 5. Set additional settings as the following menu below if needed: Thumbnail Use Block Component Thumbnail A default thumbnail image. Create New Thumbnail Select an image for the thumbnail. The file is now being saved and appeared in the Modular Configurator.

Title: Free Topstitch
Content: Objective Create a Topstitch to freely sew regardless of the points of Pattern or Internal Shape. Location Main Menu Materials Topstitch Free Topstitch 2D Toolbar Free Topstitch Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Topstitch Free Topstitch 2D Toolbar Free Topstitch Click on a point where a Topstitch begins. Move mouse to the direction where the Topstitch is going to be created. The selected area appears in red color. Click on another point where the Topstitch ends. The tTopstitch is now created with being highlighted. Note: Click-and-drag in the 2D window to encompass all segments where Topstitches to be applied. Topstitches appear on all selected segments (ver3.2.0). Use lasso selection to select Pattern Outlines and Internal Lines where Topstitches should be created on (ver3.2.0). OBJ Topstitches temporarily disappear when the Simulation is activated, but they appear again when the Simulation is deactivated (ver3.2.0). Right click when creating the Topstitch to enter specific length (ver4.2.0).

Title: MODULAR MODE: Edit Blocks
Content: Objective Open and edit Patterns in provided Blocks from the Modular Configurator or replace them with your own. Location Modular Mode Block Editor Operation Edit Patterns 1. Load Blocks from the Modular Configurator. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Modular Mode Block Editor 3. Select a Block to edit in the list of the Block Editor. Remaining Blocks are frozen. 4. Modify it with the Edit Pattern tool. 5. Once the modification is done, Simulate the according Block when the rest of the Blocks are still frozen. 6. Once the modification is completed, reselect the selected Block. All of the Blocks are activated again. Replace Patterns 1.Load Blocks from the Modular Configurator. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Modular Mode Block Editor 3. Locate Patterns out of Block Boxes or delete them. The Block Boxes remain in light grey. 4. Add desired Garment files to substitute with. 5.Click and drag the Patterns that are just loaded to matching Block Boxes. The Patterns are linked with the Block Boxes. 6. Sew the Patterns to Block Boxes. 7. Select the according Block in the Block Editor, freeze the rest, then Simulate. Note: Selected Blocks in the Block Editor are also selected in the 2D window. Editing Pattern in the Modular Mode is the same as the Simulation Mode. Deleting a segment or a point in a Pattern also deletes Sewing Lines between the Pattern and the Block Box.

Title: Show Symmetric/Instance Lines
Content: Objective Toggle the highlight around Symmetric and Instance Patterns on or off. Location Main Menu Display 2D Pattern Show Symmetric/Instance Lines Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Show Symmetric/Instance Lines Highlights around Symmetric and Instance Patterns are hidden or shown.

Title: Show 3D Line Length
Content: Objective Confirm the difference in lengths of the selected Pattern when simulated in the 3D window. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern or Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Transform Pattern or Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern Select the desired line on the 2D window. Respective properties appear in the Property Editor. See the 3D line length by following the indicated path: Property Editor Selected Line 3D Line Length

Title: Show Grainline
Content: Objective Show or hide grainline on Patterns. Location Main Menu Display 2D Pattern Show Grainline Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Show Grainline Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display 2D Pattern Show Grainline Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Show Grainline The grainline on Patterns show or disappear from the 2D window.

Title: Delete Baseline
Content: Objective Delete Baselines from the 2D window. Location Delete Selected Main Menu Edit Delete Delete All Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Delete All Baselines Operation Delete Selected Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Trace tool. Select the Baseline to be deleted. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Edit Delete The selected Baseline is deleted from the 2D window. Note: After selecting the Baseline, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to achieve the same result. Delete All Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Delete All Baselines All Baselines on the 2D window are deleted.

Title: Show Pattern Name
Content: Objective Check Pattern names to identify Pattern pieces when there are too many of them. Location Show Pattern Name Main Menu Display 2D Pattern Show Pattern Name Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D window) Show Pattern Name Edit Pattern Name 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern/ Edit Pattern Select Pattern Property Editor Name Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern/ Edit Pattern Select Pattern Property Editor Name Select and enter as desired for the Name field. Click on empty spot of the Property Editor to save the change. To name multiple patterns the same, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to select desired Patterns. Select and enter as desired for the Name field. The same name is applied to all selected Patterns and the names are numbered automatically (e.g: Pattern_1, Pattern_2 Pattern_3...). Note: When a single Pattern is cut, using the Cut feature, the Pattern name is remained but numbered behind the name (e.g.: Pattern_1, Pattern_2 Pattern_3...).

Title: Zoom Extents All (2D)
Content: Objective Set the view in the 2D window to reveal all patterns or center the 2D view to the center of the 2D grid. Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Zoom Extents All Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) Zoom Extents All The 2D view is adjusted to reveal all existing 2D Patterns, if any, or resets the view to the center of the 2D window.

Title: Order
Content: Objective When you create Patterns in the 2D window, the last Pattern created is placed on the front by default. Change the order of the Patterns as needed. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Order Bring Forward / Bring to Front / Send Backward / Send to Back Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Patterntool. Select the Pattern or Internal Line or Shape to be reordered. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Order Bring Forward / Bring to Front / Send Backward / Send to Back The selected object is reordered.

Title: Distribute
Content: Objective Distribute Patterns or/and Internal Shapes/Lines by designated intervals (ver2.5.0). Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Distribute Horizontally/Vertically Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Transform Pattern tool or the Edit Pattern tool. Select two or more Patterns or/and Internal Lines/Shapes. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Line/Shape) Distribute Horizontally/Vertically The Distribute Window appears. Enter the desired Spacing value and select OK. The selected Patterns and/or Internal Lines/Shapes are distributed horizontally or vertically by the designated intervals.

Title: Align
Content: Objective Align Patterns and Internal Shapes based on various standards (ver2.5.0). Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/ Internal Shape) Align Left/ Center/ Right/ Top/ Middle/ Bottom Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Transform Pattern tool. Select two or more Patterns or/and Internal Shapes. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/ Internal Shape) Align Left/ Center/ Right/ Top/ Middle/ Bottom The Patterns or/and Internal Shapes align to the Pattern or Internal Shape that is right clicked on. Note: You can also align Pattern outlines or Internal Lines using the 2.png Edit Pattern tool. However, be mindful that the aligning segments may transform their Patterns or Internal Shapes.

Title: Flip Horizontally/Vertically
Content: Objective Flip Patterns/Internal Shapes horizontally or vertically as needed. Location Main Menu Edit Context Menu 2D Pattern Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically (ver2.5.0) Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically Operation Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the Pattern Transform tool or the Edit Pattern tool. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Edit Context Menu 2D Pattern Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically (ver2.5.0) Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) Flip Horizontally/ Flip Vertically The selected Patterns/ Internal Shapes are flipped horizontally or vertically.

Title: Unfold
Content: Objective Draft and unfold a half Pattern to convert and use it as a full Pattern with no center line or seam. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Unfold Operation Select the Edit Pattern tool. Click on the fiducial segment that the Pattern or Internal Shape would be reflected based on. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Unfold The selected segment disappears as the Pattern unfolds.

Title: Create Smooth Curve
Content: Objective Modify Pattern outlines or Internal Lines into smooth curves. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Smooth Curve 2D Toolbar Smooth Curve Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Smooth Curve 2D Toolbar Smooth Curve Click on a segment or point to establish the first point. The point appears in grey. Drag the mouse. A grey arrow extending from the point follows the cursor. Click on another segment or point to establish the endpoint. A reference line is created between the two points. With the reference line created, click on the side that will be converted into a smooth curve. The entire side is highlighted in yellow. Click &amp drag the reference line to create the desired smooth curve. The entire outline of the selected side is replaced by the reference line. Note: Cancel Actions Cancel All Actions While using the Smooth Curve tool, press Esc or Ctrl+Z on the keyboard and all actions are undone. Cancel Last Action While using the Smooth Curve tool, press Delete or Backspace on the keyboard and the last action is undone.

Title: Convert to Curve Point (AI Bezier Curve)
Content: Objective Convert AI Bezier Curve's Segment Points to Free Curve Points. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point Operation AI Bezier Curve Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point Right click on the AI Bezier Curve or the Segment point on the curve. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Convert to Curve Point. The selected AI Bezier curve is converted to a Free Curve as its AI Bezier curve handles disappear and necessary Free Curve Points are added to maintain its original curvature. AI Bezier Curve Handles Follow the indicated guideline: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern / Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern / Curve Point Click on the AI Bezier curve to be converted. Its AI Bezier curve handles appear. Right click on the end point of the handle and select Convert to Curve Point on the pop-up menu. Its original curvature is maintained as Free Curve Points are added.

Title: Convert to Curve Point
Content: Objective Convert multiple Segment Points on a single Pattern to Curve Points (ver3.0.0). Convert multiple Segment Points on multiple Patterns to Curve Points (ver3.2.0). Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Select all Segment Points should be converted to Curve Points. Right click to access the pop-up menu. Then, select Convert to Curve Point. All selected Segment Points turn to Curve Points.

Title: Delete Curve Point
Content: Objective Delete unnecessary curve points when editing Patterns. When all curve points on a segment is deleted, it turns to a straight line. Location Delete Selected Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point Delete All Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Delete All Curve Points Operation Delete Selected Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curve Point 2D Toolbar Edit Curve Point Right click on the curve point to be deleted and select Delete on the pop-up menu. Or, select the curve point and hit Delete key on the keyboard. Note: When you delete a segment point added on a curved line, all curved points on that specific line are deleted and so as the curvature. Delete All Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the 2.png Edit Pattern tool. Then, select a segment which all curved points should be deleted. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Delete All Curve Points All curve points on the selected segment are deleted.

Title: Edit Curvature
Content: Objective Convert a straight line to a curved line or edit a curved line's curvature. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curvature 2D Toolbar Edit Curvature Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Curvature 2D Toolbar Edit Curvature Click and drag a straight line to convert it to a curved line. AI Bezier handles are added to the both end of the selected line. Or, click and drag a curved line to edit the curvature.

Title: Create AI Bezier Curve
Content: Objective Create curves in Marvelous Designer similarly how they are drawn in Adobe Illustrator (ver3.0.0). Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Polygon or Internal Polygon/Line 2D Toolbar Polygon or Internal Polygon/Line Operation Create AI Curves Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Polygon or Internal Polygon/Line 2D Toolbar Polygon or Internal Polygon/Line Click and drag on the 2D window. The curve is created as the blue handle appears. Continue to drag to adjust curvature. When the desired curvature is achieved, let go the mouse cursor. To draw a straight line or change the direction of the curve, click on the point created at last. Then, continue to draw polygon or Internal Polygon/Line. Cancel Actions To cancel all actions, hit Esc key or Ctrl + Z keys on the keyboard. All the actions taken to create polygon or Internal Polygon/Line are undone. To cancel the last step, hit Delete key or Backspace key on the keyboard. The point created at last is undone.

Title: Replace as Pattern Outline
Content: Objective Substitute Pattern outlines with Internal Lines, establishing the Internal Line as the new Pattern outline. Location 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Create an internal line to be substituted with the Pattern outline. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Click on the Internal Line and the Pattern outline that should be replaced. The Internal Line and Pattern outline are highlighted in yellow. Right-click on the selected Internal Line or Pattern outline. A pop-up menu appears. Select the Replace as Pattern Outline option. The selected Pattern outline is replaced with the shape of the Internal Line. The original Pattern outline appears as a Reference Line.

Title: Add Point to Intersection
Content: Objective Add Segment Points to where segments intersect. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Edit Pattern 2D Toolbar Edit Pattern Select the segment that is crossed. The selected segment is highlighted in yellow. Right click on the selected segment. A pop-up menu appears. Select the Add Point to Intersection option. A Segment Point is added to where the segment intersects. Note: The point is only added to the selected segment. To add points to both intersecting segments, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard and select both segment before right-clicking and selecting Add Point to Intersection option.

Title: Add Point/Split Line
Content: Objective Add points and split a segment into multiple segments. Just simply click or enter values to add points on segments. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Add Point/Split Line 2D Toolbar Add Point/Split Line Operation Add Point with a Click Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Add Point/Split Line 2D Toolbar Add Point/Split Line Hover the mouse over the segment where the point is to be added. Then, click once. Add Point with Entered Values Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Edit Add Point/Split Line 2D Toolbar Add Point/Split Line Hover the mouse over the segment where the point is to be added. Right click to access the Split Line window. Enter the desired values as below: Split Into Two Lines Line 1 / Line 2 The line will be divided into two lines based on the reference point which was created when you hover the mouse over and right click the segment. The shorter side is indicated as Line 1, and the longer side is indicated as Line 2. Enter the desired value in either Line 1 or Line 2 to split the segment into two lines. Ratio The ratio of the line to be split is 100%. The line can be divided into two lines based on the ratio. Enter the desired ratio in either Line 1 or Line 2 to split the segment into two lines. This function is often used split a line into two identical segments or to add a point at its 33.3%. Split by Length Segment Length Enter the segment length which the whole line should be divided according to the interval. To reverse the direction that points are added, select Reverse Direction. Number of Segments Enter the number of segments the selected line should be divided into. It is set as 2 by default (ver3.2.0). Direction Reverse the direction that points are added (ver3.2.0). Uniform Split Enter the number of segments the line should be divided into. The line is equally divided accordingly. Note: Additional points can be added to multiple segments as they are detected as a single line. To use this function, select multiple segments where additional points should added to, right-click then select Split (ver3.2.0).

Title: Segment Darts
Content: Objective Add or modify Darts located along Pattern outlines. Location Create Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Point) Add Dart Edit Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Edit Dart Operation Create Choose the Edit pattern (Z) tool from the 2D toolbar and click on the point which a Dart should be added. The clicked point is selected and highlighted in yellow. Follow the indicated guideline below. Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Point) Add Dart The Dart window appears. Adjust the below options as needed and click OK. Name Description Total Width Set the total horizontal length of a Dart. Dart Arm Width Set 1/2 of the horizontal length of a Dart. Length Set the depth of a Dart. The Dart is created based on the above settings. Edit Choose the Edit pattern (Z) tool from the 2D toolbar and select Pattern outlines that form the Dart. The segments are selected and highlighted in yellow. Follow the indicated guideline below. Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Segment) Edit Dart The Dart window appears. Similarly, adjust the options in the Dart window and select OK. Any modified settings are reflected on the Dart.

Title: Trace
Content: Objective Use the Trace function to convert lines/shapes/area to Patterns. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Trace 2D Toolbar Trace Operation Trace as a Pattern Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Trace 2D Toolbar Trace Select the Baselines to be traced. Right click on the selected Baselines to access the pop-up menu. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Trace as a Pattern. The selected Baselines are traced as a Pattern. Trace as an Internal Shape Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Trace 2D Toolbar Trace Select the Baselines to be traced. Right click on the selected Baselines to access the pop-up menu. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Trace as an Internal Shape. When the selected lines are intersected, the intersection is joined and the lines are traced as one shape. Trace as Internal Lines/Shapes Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Trace 2D Toolbar Trace Select the Baselines to be traced. Right click on the selected Baselines to access the pop-up menu. The right click pop-up menu appears. Select Trace as Internal Lines/Shapes. The selected lines will be traced as they are. Note: To easily select a closed shape, double click on the Internal Line. Click and drag to select multiple Internal Lines at once. All Internal Lines within the marquee box are selected.

Title: Mirror Paste
Content: Objective Mirror Paste copied Pattern/Internal Shape. Location Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Shape) Mirror Paste (Ctrl + R) Operation Navigate to 2D toolbar and select Transform Pattern Tool or Edit Pattern Tool. Then, copy the desired Pattern or Internal Shape. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern/Internal Shape) Mirror Paste (Ctrl + R) The clone of copied Pattern/Internal Shape follows along the mouse cursor. Click on the 2D window or on the Pattern to place the Pattern or the Internal Shape. Note: Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to move the duplicated Pattern on a straight line or on a diagonal line. Select the desired Pattern and hit Ctrl + C (Copy) / Ctrl +V(Paste), Ctrl + R(Mirror Paste) on the keyboard to copy and paste Patterns to a separate CLO window (ver3.0.0).

Title: Invert Selection
Content: Objective Invert the Pattern selection, selecting the Patterns currently not selected. Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (On Pattern) Invert Selection Main Menu Edit Invert Selection Operation Select Patterns that will be deselected. Follow the indicated guideline as below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (On Pattern) Invert Selection Main Menu Edit Invert Selection All Patterns that were selected are deselected, while the remaining patterns are selected.

Title: Create 2D Measurements
Content: Internal Shape Objective View the position of Internal Shapes from the Pattern outline with 2D measurements (ver2.5.0). Location Property Editor 2D Measurements To Outline/To Center Operation 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern Tool Select the Internal Shape/Dart. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor 2D Measurements To Outline/To Center Select the desired 2D Measurements to display. To Outline View the 2D Measurements from the left, right, top, and bottom of the Internal Shape to the Pattern outline. To Center View the 2D Measurements from the center of the Internal Shape to the left, right, top, and bottom of the Pattern outline. 2D Measurements appear based on the selected items. Internal Line Objective View the position of Internal Lines or segments of Internal Shapes from the Pattern outline with 2D Measurements (ver2.5.0). Location Property Editor 2D Measurements To Center Operation 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern Tool Select the Internal Shape/Dart. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor 2D Measurements To Outline/To Center Select the desired 2D Measurements to display. 2D Measurements appear based on the selected items. Internal Point Objective View the position of internal points or internal curve points from the Pattern outline with 2D Measurements (ver2.5.0). Location Property Editor 2D Measurements To Center Operation 2D Toolbar Transform Pattern Tool Select the Internal Shape/Dart. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor 2D Measurements To Outline/To Center Select the desired 2D Measurements to display. 2D Measurements appear based on the selected items.

Title: Create Multiple Patterns or Internal Shapes and Input Intervals
Content: Objective Designate the number of shapes and input the interval when creating Patterns or Internal Lines. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Applicable Tools 2D Toolbar Applicable Tools Note: Applicable tools are as follows: Rectangle tool, Internal Rectangle tool, Ellipse tool, Internal Ellipse tool. Operation Follow the indicated guideline as below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Applicable Tool 2D Toolbar Applicable Tools Click once on the 2D window. The pop-up window with options to create the selected Pattern or Internal Shape appears. Enter desired values for options below the Replicate category and click OK. Name Description Number of Shapes Set the number of replicated shapes. Interval Set the distance between each Pattern or Internal Shape/Line. Angle Set the direction that the replicated Patterns are placed. The Patterns or Internal Shapes/Lines are replicated based on the settings.

Title: Internal Ellipse
Content: Objective Create internal ellipses or circles within Patterns. Location Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Ellipse 2D Toolbar Internal Ellipse Operation Create Internal Ellipse Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Ellipse 2D Toolbar Internal Ellipse Click and drag within a Pattern to freehand an ellipse. Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to create a circle. Release the mouse to complete the Internal Ellipse or the Internal Circle. Note: While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Ctrl key on the keyboard to create it by the center point (ver.5.1.0). While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Shift + Ctrl keys to create a full circle by its center point (ver.5.1.0). Create Internal Ellipse with Entered Values Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu 2D Pattern Create Internal Ellipse 2D Toolbar Internal Ellipse Click once within a Pattern. The Create Ellipse window appears. Enter the desired values. Diameter Set the diameter of the Internal Circle. Radius Set the radius of the Internal Circle (ver3.2.0). Link to maintain the width and height ratio. Circumference Set the circumference of the Internal Circle (ver3.2.0). Position To Outline Set the position of the left, right, top, and bottom of the Internal Circles from the Pattern outline (ver2.5.0). To Center Set the position of the center of the Internal Circle from the left, right, top, and bottom of the Pattern outline (ver2.5.0). Note: Internal Shape Tool Group
